method: OpenStreetMap building way 228473354, name 'Wright Laboratory', addr 272 Whitney Avenue, operator Yale University (building=university), used verbatim. The laboratory's own contact page gives '272 Whitney Avenue' as its navigation address, matching the OSM address tag.
name: Yale Wright Laboratory building (272 Whitney Avenue)
notes: The Wright Laboratory complex also includes buildings OSM names 'Wright Laboratory West' (268 Whitney Avenue), 'Electron Accelerator Laboratory' (270 Whitney Avenue) and 'Wright Annex'; the laboratory's own history page says only that the Yale Atomic Research Lab (EAL) 'is part of the current site of Wright Lab', so none of them is drawn: no fetched official source ties those OSM buildings to the laboratory.
HAYSTAC is sourced only as 'in operation at Yale University's Wright laboratory'; the room is not stated.

summary.plain: The Wright Laboratory building at 272 Whitney Avenue on Yale's campus in New Haven, Connecticut, which hosts the HAYSTAC axion experiment.
